archived_by: greploop fix wave 1 (PR #161) — boot.rs CLI probe fix

residual_findings.title: /providers.available inaccurate — HostManager::start() marks providers available without CLI probe (qc1 W-001)
residual_findings.tracking: Greptile P1 on PR #161 — UX false-promise issue (UI starts session that fails at process-spawn time)
residual_findings.closure_note: Fixed in greploop iteration 1 — boot.rs now probes CLI presence via which::which() before register_provider; providers absent from PATH are not registered; closes the false-promise UX issue.

resolution.mechanism: boot.rs wraps each register_provider call in which::which(cmd).is_ok() check; absent CLIs are skipped with a warn-level log
